caption: The ancilla |−⟩ stays unchanged; the parity oracle turns f(x) into the signs +1, −1, −1, +1 on |00⟩, |01⟩, |10⟩, |11⟩. The final amplitudes are +1/2, −1/2, −1/2, +1/2.

spec.title: Worked example: n = 2, f = x₁⊕x₂
spec.aria: A table of the four two-bit inputs |00⟩, |01⟩, |10⟩, |11⟩ with parity f(x) = 0, 1, 1, 0, kickback signs +1, −1, −1, +1, final amplitudes ±1/2, and the ancilla unchanged as |−⟩.
